bibl.title: Zuckers Korrespondenz zu seinen Grabungen in Soknopaiou Nesos (Dīmīh).
bibl.seg: Holger Essler, Zuckers Korrespondenz zu seinen Grabungen in Soknopaiou Nesos (Dīmīh).
bibl.note: Edition of documents and letters related to the excavations at Soknopaiou Nesos (Dimeh) directed by Friedrich Zucker in 1909 and 1910. Authors and addressees are L. Borchardt, J.É. Gautier, G. Maspero, F. Zucker.
